Question Choices: An angle measures 35 degrees. What type of angle is it?: Acute Right Obtuse Straight
Hints: Compare with 90 degrees and 180 degrees: acute below 90, right 90, obtuse between 90 and 180, straight 180.
Solution: 35 degrees is less than 90 and greater than 0, so it is acute.
